heading.description: Connect TidyPro to Mailchimp and your automation tools.
heading.title: Integrations

mailchimp.description: Push your customers into a Mailchimp audience for newsletters and campaigns.
mailchimp.howTo: Create a free key at Mailchimp → Account → Extras → API keys. No OAuth app needed.
mailchimp.note: Sync is manual and one-way: it adds customers to the chosen audience. Members are added as “subscribed if new”, so anyone who unsubscribed is never resubscribed.

setupSteps: In Zapier, create a Zap and choose “Webhooks by Zapier” as the trigger, then “Catch Hook”.
Copy the unique webhook URL Zapier gives you.
Paste it below, pick the events to send, and click Add webhook.
Click Test to send a sample event, then finish setting up your Zap.
